data.subject: A personal note from the founder of Okiza — The AI CMO
data.message:
I noticed you recently started exploring Okiza. As the founder, I personally wanted to welcome you to your new AI CMO.

We built Okiza because modern marketing is fragmented and reactive. With Okiza as your autonomous AI CMO, our multi-agent studios continuously analyze competitor movements, optimize generative search engine visibility (GEO), and draft high-converting campaigns around the clock.

I would love to learn more about your brand and personally ensure our growth models are tuned to your exact goals. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute 1-on-1 walkthrough with me?
